statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-87910: when tarfile extracts a link on a system that cannot create it, it falls back to extracting the linked member and runs the extraction filter twice; the result of one call was ignored, so a filter that returned None to skip the member did not stop it from being extracted. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157265 (3.12 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/764fd0af8d9e19d3684a58d2e58bf770f0605036), first released in CPython 3.12.15; see https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/57TBTLL2W6APMZR3A25B2YV7GL3EPTDJ/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-87910. Checked makelink_with_filter() in Lib/tarfile.py for the check of the first filter result that the fix adds (if filtered is None: return) in the python-3.12 package of every build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 3.12.12-r0 to 3.12.16-r4, x86_64 and aarch64; both architectures agree. Builds before 3.12.14-r2 lack the fix; 3.12.14-r2 and every later build have it (3.12.14-r2 carries a backport made before the 3.12.15 release; 3.12.15-r0 and later ship the upstream fix). The range ends at 3.12.14-r2.

CVE-2026-87910: when tarfile extracts a link on a system that cannot create it, it falls back to extracting the linked member and runs the extraction filter twice; the result of one call was ignored, so a filter that returned None to skip the member did not stop it from being extracted. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157265 (3.13 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/9c17bace90f88dfba6d0e2fe23c8e7ae35f83955), first released in CPython 3.13.16; see https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/57TBTLL2W6APMZR3A25B2YV7GL3EPTDJ/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-87910. The second filter call came from the fix for https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/151558 (3.13 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/771d12dda5140313db0ac550292987975651bbde, CPython 3.13.15). Checked makelink_with_filter() in Lib/tarfile.py in the python-3.13 package of every build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 3.13.12-r0 to 3.13.18-r4, x86_64 and aarch64; both architectures agree. 3.13.12-r0 to 3.13.14-r0 run the filter once and skip the member when it returns None, because they predate the gh-151558 change; 3.13.14-r1, which backports that change, to 3.13.15-r1 run it twice and ignore the first result; 3.13.15-r2 is the first build with the fix, a DHI backport of the upstream change to CPython 3.13.15, and 3.13.16-r0 and later ship the upstream fix. The range starts at 0, as in the CVE record (CPython 3.13.0 up to 3.13.16), so every build before the fix reads affected, and ends at 3.13.15-r2.

Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157265 (3.14 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/a4919937a4e1e69a0d178909c6f20557eca5d1d0), first released in CPython 3.14.9; see https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/57TBTLL2W6APMZR3A25B2YV7GL3EPTDJ/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-87910. Checked makelink_with_filter() in Lib/tarfile.py in every published build of the DHI Debian 13 python-3.14 source (its libpython-3.14 packages), 3.14.5-0 to 3.14.10-6, on amd64 and arm64; both architectures agree. 3.14.5-0 to 3.14.7-1 ignore the first filter result. 3.14.7-2 is the first build with the fix, a DHI backport of the upstream change to CPython 3.14.7, 3.14.8-0 keeps it, and 3.14.10-0 to 3.14.10-6 ship the upstream fix. The range ends at 3.14.7-2.
